remarks: Welcome to 101 Grove Street - a stylish and fully updated townhouse offering a modern layout with incredible natural light across multiple levels. Enjoy maintenance-free living in this beautiful complex, with a well-maintained courtyard. This 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features unique split-level living, giving each room its own space and character. The entry level offers a flexible office or den, a convenient half bath, and direct access to the attached 1-car garage. Upstairs, the updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry, along with a dining area and slider to a private balcony deck. The next level features a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace and a charming bay window. A bright bedroom with an en-suite bath and laundry completes the next floor, while the top level is home to a private primary suite with generous closet space and a luxurious full bath featuring a jacuzzi tub. With newer flooring and appliances throughout, this move-in-ready home offers both comfort and style. Conveniently located near I-95 and just minutes from downtown Stamford's restaurants, shops, nightlife, and entertainment. Pets conditional, excellent income and credit required, no smoking, move in ASAP. See it quickly before it's snatched off this market!
